verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI explicitly supports `viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query>` with output to a destination file, and docs confirm export in various formats plus querying tabular/binary data with SQL or MQL, alongside API-based data access. This directly satisfies querying and exporting collected data for offline analysis via CLI/API/SQL. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the SQL export workflow and details on API-level (not just CLI) query ergonomics.
